messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] P95 latency spike in eu-west-1 after rollout 'deploy-wave-v2'. token-p99 tail jumped 3.2s -> 11.8s, error rate ~0.6%. Affected: inference-runtime. Paging channel created.

alice: oncall here, looking at canaries. not rolling back yet, gathering logs. initial suspicion: prefetch/batching changes in v2.

ben: seeing repeated 'kernel_fallback' in serving logs across canary hosts, and batch window seems to be growing for short requests. copying logs.

carla: metric check: GPU memory pressure spikes on nodes handling canary traffic, eviction_count ↑, swap/paging symptoms. could be kernel selection thrash causing mem fragmentation.

david: support: one customer (acct: oak-data) reported slow embeddings, increased latency but no 5xx. collecting impacted request ids. need ETA for customer-impact list.

frank: cust-success: we've got three customers with noticeable slowdowns (non-blocking). holding on public status page until we confirm mitigation.

alice: grabbing logs now. snippet:
```
2024-10-12T15:07:12Z [INFO] kernel_fallback chosen kernel_id=kv_v2 alt=kv_fast seq_len=64 mem_est=18GB
2024-10-12T15:07:13Z [WARN] eviction triggered, free_mem=200MB
2024-10-12T15:07:14Z [INFO] batch_window extended from 5ms to 60ms for route=text-gen
```

ben: that aligns. new kernel selector is probabilistically picking a fallback on mixed seq workloads which increases KV cache churn. net result: more page faults, higher tail latency.

alice: I'm going to hit the kill-switch for the rollout flag in eu-west-1 to stop new v2 assignments. command: `/infractl feature-toggle set runtime.deploy_v2 false --region eu-west-1`

alice: executing kill-switch now.

incident-bot: runbook update: step 'toggle-kill-flag' executed by alice at 1755554385. Traffic routing adjusted to prefer v1.

carla: post-toggle metrics: within ~90s p95 dropped back to ~1.1s. kernel_fallback events down ~80%. some throughput degradation remains for long-sequence workloads (batching not fully recovered).

ben: working hypothesis: kernel selection heuristic in v2 created a corner case for mixed short/long sequences, causing repeated kernel swaps and KV cache invalidations. will run memprof and kernel-selector unit tests.

emma: product: good catch. we need a postmortem and a rollout guard for kernel-selector heuristics (perf unit gating). no re-enable until validated.

david: drafting customer communication: "We observed elevated inference latency after a recent rollout. We applied a mitigation (rollback of the rollout flag) and service performance has returned to normal. We're investigating root cause and will follow up." Approving send?

frank: approve, send now to impacted customers. include timeline and mitigations.

alice: handing off to ben for RCA and follow-up. next oncall handoff at 1755555000 UTC — @ben you own until RCA posted.

ben: ack. I'll run a synthetic mixed-seq workload against a v2 canary in a staging env to reproduce, capture kernel decisions, and prepare a revert/patch plan.

carla: creating incident page and timeline, setting severity to Sev2. I'll watch for any eviction spikes and alert eng-sre if evictions resume.

incident-bot: incident severity updated to Sev2 by carla at 1755554520. Paging concluded; oncall handoff required for RCA.

alice: adding dashboards/log links: https://dashboards.redwood/runtime/incident/1755554321 and logs: https://logs.redwood/runtime?query=kernel_fallback%20%22deploy-wave-v2%22

ben: will post RCA and proposed fix (revert kernel selector change or add guard) within the hour. for now, rollback + kill-switch mitigated customer impact. :white_check_mark:
